name: Bar Chart
description: Rows of grouped bar charts, three bars to a group in three inks standing on a ruled baseline, each series rising and falling in a smooth trend across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --h1: @calc(@rn(-15, 135, 1.6) + @r(-6, 6)); --h2: @calc(@rn(-15, 135, 1.4) + @r(-6, 6)); --h3: @calc(@rn(-15, 135, 1.8) + @r(-6, 6)); background: linear-gradient(var(--color4), var(--color4)) 0 90% / 100% 2.6% no-repeat, linear-gradient(@p(var(--color1)), var(--color1)) 10.81% $(round(((89.5 - max(8, min(84, h1))) / (100 - max(8, min(84, h1))) * 100) * 100) / 100)% / 26% $(round((max(8, min(84, h1))) * 100) / 100)% no-repeat; :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 37%; width: 26%; top: 0; bottom: 10.5%; background: @p(var(--color2)); -webkit-clip-path: inset($(round(((89.5 - max(8, min(84, h2))) / 0.895) * 100) / 100)% 0% 0% 0%); clip-path: inset($(round(((89.5 - max(8, min(84, h2))) / 0.895) * 100) / 100)% 0% 0% 0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 66%; width: 26%; top: 0; bottom: 10.5%; background: @p(var(--color3)); -webkit-clip-path: inset($(round(((89.5 - max(8, min(84, h3))) / 0.895) * 100) / 100)% 0% 0% 0%); clip-path: inset($(round(((89.5 - max(8, min(84, h3))) / 0.895) * 100) / 100)% 0% 0% 0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
